- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile(page)`, `onEnd`) + `PluginPipeline` that runs every hook across all plugins in registration order.
- **`src/engine.ts`** — core `SSG` engine orchestrates the pipeline: `start()` fires `onStart`; `build()` cleans output, runs `beforeBuild`, feeds each markdown file through the `onFile` chain (writing `<slug>.html`), then `afterBuild`/`onEnd`.
- **`src/plugins/`** — built-in plugins: `markdown.ts` (gray-matter + marked parsing), `template.ts` (Handlebars/fallback rendering + index), `dev-server.ts` (HTTP, live-reload injection, WebSocket, chokidar watcher).
- **`src/config.ts` + `ssg.config.ts`** — plugins loaded from config; falls back to built-ins if missing. CLI (`src/cli.ts`) builds the engine from loaded plugins.
- **`src/build.ts` / `src/serve.ts`** — thin wrappers over the engine (external API unchanged: `buildSite`, `collectPages`, `startDevServer`, `injectLiveReload`, etc.).
